_design_only: CANDIDATE contract — NOT created, NOT published in this WO. Requires a separate publication-contract WO.
ttl_rationale: a stale plan is dangerous; positive TTL with fail-loud expiry preferred over persistence; TTL ~= 2x cadence
overwrite_semantics: exact-one-key; latest overwrites in place; NO second key
refresh_cadence: only when idempotency tuple changes (digest-gated); expiry if not refreshed
stale_behaviour: key expires (fail-loud absence) rather than serving a stale plan
consumer_governance: a published proposal is NOT an execution request and MUST NOT be auto-consumed by any executor
